# Sahibzaade Academy

Sahibzaade Academy is a music school in Brampton, Ontario.
The academy provides in-person classes.

## Classes

- Gurmat Kirtan
- Taus
- Dilruba
- Rabab
- Jori
- Tabla
- Gurbani Santhya
- Gurmat Maryada
